overview_description.description: Foodstation is a platform for food service providers, turk, and live cooking stations for events. It is designed to provide direct delivery, catering, and food truck to order food directly. It is an online platform that connects users who want to order takeout from restaurants with a network​ who are available to provide the delivery service.
